title: Millenium
lyrics_plain:
Our Father who art in heaven
Hallowed be thy name
Thy kingdom come thy will be done
On earth and in heaven
Give us today our daily bread
And forgive our sins
As we forgive each one of those
Who sins against us
And lead us not through the time of trial
But deliver us from evil
For thine is the kingdom
The power and the glory
Our Father who art in heaven
Hallowed be thy name
Thy kingdom come thy will be done
On earth and in heaven
Give us today our daily bread
And forgive our sins
As we forgive each one of those
Who sins against us
And lead us not through the time of trial
But deliver us from evil
For thine is the kingdom
The power and the glory
Let all the people sing Amen
In every tribe and tongue
Let every heart's desire be joined
To see the kingdom come
Let every hope and every dream
Becalled in love by name
Let all the world sing with one voice
Let the people say Amen
Let all the people sing Amen
In every tribe and tongue

Let every hope and every dream
be called in love by name

Let the people say Amen

be called in love by name
